corpus.subject: Refund manual review
corpus.body: All current refund requests require manual review, including requests below $20. A low amount alone never bypasses review.

corpus.subject: Refund customer Elm exception
corpus.statement: Elm refunds under $10 may use automatic approval unless fraud is flagged.
corpus.body: Only customer Elm has automatic refund approval for amounts strictly below $10. Exactly $10 requires manual review. Fraud-flagged requests always require manual review, including Elm requests below $10.

corpus.subject: Refund low value suggestion
corpus.statement: A suggestion proposes automatic refund approval below $20.
corpus.body: Brainstorm only: automatic approval below $20 has been suggested but has not been approved or shipped. It does not change current manual review.

corpus.subject: Checkout reservation timeout current
corpus.statement: Checkout inventory reservations expire after 15 minutes.
corpus.body: Current checkout inventory reservations expire after 15 minutes. Payment authorization does not extend the reservation. Inventory is released on expiry.

corpus.subject: Checkout reservation timeout future decision
corpus.statement: A 30 minute inventory reservation timeout is approved but unshipped.
corpus.body: The practitioner approved a future 30 minute checkout reservation timeout. It has not shipped. Current implementation still uses 15 minutes.

corpus.subject: Payout reconciliation assertion A
corpus.statement: Payout reconciliation runs at 02:00 UTC according to operations record A.
corpus.body: Operations record A reports payout reconciliation at 02:00 UTC. A conflicting record B reports 03:00 UTC; the disagreement has not been resolved.

corpus.subject: Payout reconciliation assertion B
corpus.statement: Payout reconciliation runs at 03:00 UTC according to operations record B.
corpus.body: Operations record B reports payout reconciliation at 03:00 UTC. A conflicting record A reports 02:00 UTC; the disagreement has not been resolved.

corpus.subject: Soft hold checkout definition
corpus.statement: A soft hold means an inventory reservation, not a payment charge.
corpus.body: In checkout terminology, soft hold means an inventory reservation. It neither charges nor authorizes payment. Payment authorization is a separate operation.

corpus.subject: Legacy export limit
corpus.body: Legacy records report a 500 row export limit. The source does not establish whether the rule is implemented today.

corpus.subject: Historical inventory hold duration
corpus.statement: Before September 2026 inventory reservations expired after 5 minutes.
corpus.body: Before September 1, 2026, checkout inventory reservations expired after 5 minutes. The later current rule is 15 minutes.

messages.text: As observed in checkout, stock is reserved for a quarter of an hour and payment authorization does not prolong it.
We could introduce automatic refunds under $7 for customer Fir. This is only a suggestion; it is not approved or implemented.
As the authorized product owner, I explicitly approve future automatic refunds under $9 for customer Pine. The change has not shipped.
